column1: # zengif find_nearest optimization — byte-identical-output correctness proof
# Method: decode each corpus GIF, re-encode every canvas-sized frame through the
# 64-color cube palette), and sha256 the encoded GIF bytes. The encoded bytes
# depend on the palette index find_nearest returns for every pixel, so identical
# hashes between the scalar baseline and the branchless chunked-min optimization
# prove identical indices (including tie-breaks). Harness: examples/find_nearest_hash.rs.
# Result: ALL 9 encodable corpus files produced BYTE-IDENTICAL sha256 between
# baseline (scalar `if dist < best_dist`) and optimized (chunked (dist<<8)|idx min).
# 2 files (issue_1455_oversized.gif, oob.gif) intentionally fail decode and were skipped.
# Columns: sha256<TAB>file   (this hash is the SAME for baseline and optimized)
